summary: Israeli forces eliminated Muhammad Naeim Jendiyeh, head of military security for Hamas's Shajaiya Brigade, who was involved in kidnapping Lt. Col. Daniel Peretz and holding hostages. Iranian military and political leaders vowed revenge for Ayatollah Khamenei's death while funeral proceedings took place in Tehran. Israeli forces also arrested eight wanted individuals in the Kfar Mghamas area of Binyamin brigade during coordinated operations.
key_points: Israeli forces eliminated Muhammad Naeim Jendiyeh, head of military security for Hamas's Shajaiya Brigade, who participated in kidnapping Lt. Col. Daniel Peretz and holding hostages including Yotam Haim, Samar al-Talalkha, and Elon Samriz. (Source: @inon_yttach/9261)

Israeli Dovdokhan unit forces arrested eight wanted individuals in Kfar Mghamas area of Binyamin brigade during Shin Bet-coordinated operations targeting terrorists who attacked Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/24507)
Iranian Army Commander Major General Hatami vowed revenge for the blood of martyred Leader Khamenei and other martyrs with greater resolve against Iran's enemies. (Source: @presstv/196756)
Funeral ceremonies for Ayatollah Khamenei proceeded in Tehran's Grand Mosalla with international delegations including India, Oman, and Pakistan attending. (Source: @presstv/196758)
Iranian Parliament Speaker Kalibaf warned that if US and Israel do not fulfill obligations, Iran will take appropriate measures in response. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93337)
Lebanese President Joseph Aoun stated that separating Lebanon issue from US-Iran negotiations is problematic and allows Israeli military to maintain control. (Source: @asafroz/50962)
Posters appeared in Tehran streets featuring Hamas founder Sheikh Ahmed Yassin and Hezbollah founder Hussein bin Badr al-Din with messages of revenge. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374268)

sections.threat_assessment: Iranian military leadership under Major General Hatami has explicitly vowed revenge for Khamenei's death, indicating potential escalation in regional operations. The elimination of senior Hamas military figure Jendiyeh demonstrates ongoing Israeli targeting of hostage-taking networks. Lebanese political statements suggest continued tension over Israeli military presence and territorial control issues.
sections.regional_response: International delegations from India, Oman, and Pakistan attended Khamenei's funeral, signaling regional solidarity with Iran. Lebanese President Aoun's statements reflect ongoing diplomatic tensions regarding Israeli-Lebanese negotiations. Iraqi political figures met with Iranian leadership to discuss expanded cooperation amid regional mourning period.
sections.intelligence_notes: Israeli indictment of Jerusalem resident for Iranian intelligence activities reveals continued covert operations targeting Israeli infrastructure. Hostage documentation procedures suggest ongoing efforts to process captivity cases from recent Gaza operations. Mossad operational security concerns were noted during funeral proceedings in Tehran.
